SELECT date_trunc('month', opened_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date AS period,
       category AS category,
       count(*) AS count,
       round(avg(days_to_close)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days_to_close,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_to_close))::numeric, 2) AS median_days_to_close,
       round((percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_to_close))::numeric, 2) AS p90_days_to_close,
       round(avg(days_to_first_response)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days_to_first_response,
       round(avg(days_waiting_on_parts)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days_waiting_on_parts,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN parts_vendor IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 3) AS parts_ordered_rate,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN reassignment_count > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 3) AS reassignment_rate
FROM work_order_facts
WHERE 1=1
  AND opened_at >= ('2025-06-01'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')
  AND opened_at <  ('2026-11-16'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', opened_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date, category
ORDER BY period
LIMIT 200

args.subject: Escalation: Tower B plumbing parts backorders driving extended closures
args.body:
Lakeshore Health’s review of March–October 2026 plumbing work orders shows a concentrated delay pattern in North Campus Tower B tied to ACME-supplied plumbing parts. Tower B plumbing jobs averaged 7.23 days to close versus 1.89 days in the same building before March 2026, with ACME parts orders averaging 16.22 days to close and 14.39 days waiting on parts.

Representative work orders show repeated backorder/no-ETA notes for Aqualine SV-200 diaphragm kits and solenoid modules, with clinical rooms taken out of service while awaiting parts:
- WO-2026-009732: 24.2 days to close; 20.9 days waiting on parts; repeated ACME backorder/ETA-pushed notes.
- WO-2026-011175: 26.9 days to close; 20.9 days waiting on parts; ACME solenoid module backordered.
- WO-2026-011937: 24.0 days to close; 20.0 days waiting on parts; ACME diaphragm kit backordered.

Please review the supply chain issue for Aqualine SV-200 kits/modules and other Tower B plumbing parts and provide a recovery plan.
asks: Confirm current stock and lead times for Aqualine SV-200 diaphragm kits and solenoid modules.
Provide expedited sourcing or acceptable substitutes for backordered Tower B plumbing parts.
Propose a min/max stocking plan for high-use Tower B plumbing parts to prevent repeat 14–21 day waits.
